title: Exact descent for the specified coherent twisted PBC inverse image
statement: Fix prime l, algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, a quasi-compact f:X→Y of Noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which l is invertible, a compactification c and d≥0. Let H_E and A(h) be exactly the twisted inverse image and normalized scalar comparison of [def-pur-rational-purity-scalar-models]. Suppose the displayed associator-coherence equation for A holds. Form the StageSystem morphism with functors H_E, comparisons A(h), and that coherence proof. Its functor on the actual PBC Qbar pair categories is additive and admits a shift comparison making it triangulated, namely ExactDescent of [prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors]. No finite-stage adjunction, purity map, coefficient purity square or retract assertion is claimed.

source.place: Parent Steps 2--5: exactness of the coherent twisted-pullback family after rationalization and common-stage descent

proof.text: Completed pullback, Tate tensor and the even shift preserve the lattice triangles and have the usual compatible shift structures. Restrict their exact linear operations and shift equations to the full lattice categories.

Apply exact rational transport to these functors and comparisons. The specified scalar beta is shift-compatible because each of its three factors is. Conjugate by the canonical stage normalization, which is compatible with the same shifts.
The given coherence and these finite-stage exactness and shift data define a CoherentExactMorphism. Apply pbcDescentFunctors and project its ExactDescent clause.

theorem pbcPurityTwisted_exactDescent
    (hcoh : ∀ {E F L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω} (h : E ≤ F) (k : F ≤ L)
      (K : pbcStageCategory l Ω Y E),
      ((pbcScalarSystem l Ω X dX.out iX.out).T k).map
          ((pbcPurityStageA l Ω f c d h).hom.app K) ≫
        (pbcPurityStageA l Ω f c d k).hom.app
          (((pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out).T h).obj K) ≫
        (pbcPurityStageTwisted l Ω f c d L).map
          (((pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out).assoc h k).hom.app K) =
      ((pbcScalarSystem l Ω X dX.out iX.out).assoc h k).hom.app
          ((pbcPurityStageTwisted l Ω f c d E).obj K) ≫
        (pbcPurityStageA l Ω f c d (h.trans k)).hom.app K) :
    StageSystem.Morphism.ExactDescent
      ({ Φ := pbcPurityStageTwisted l Ω f c d
         β := pbcPurityStageA l Ω f c d
         coh := hcoh } : StageSystem.Morphism
        (pbcScalarSystem l Ω Y dY.out iY.out) (pbcScalarSystem l Ω X dX.out iX.out))
